desc:
🔥 Use CODE "like5k" and LIKE the game for free steamers!
👍 NEW CODE releases once the game gets 7000 Upvotes!
🎁 Special Code: dumpling2026

Welcome to Dumpling Unbox & Trading — a fast, social trading game with mystery steamers and HUGE collectible Dumplings! Drop onto a trade board, open steamers, and haggle your way to the rarest finds.

How to play
1. Stand on a trade board with another player.
2. Drop Dumplings from your inventory.
3. Use the three buttons: Cancel (red button to take everything back), Add (blue button ask for more), Agree (green button to swap).

The shop sells steamers and refreshes every 5 minutes.
Steamers come in different rarities and random quantities — rarer steamers are less likely.
Open steamers to get dumplings in different styles, rarities, and sizes — the bigger the Dumpling, the more the stars, meaning the rarer the drop.
